subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.expires: Access is available until this date
subscription.local: Local access without an end date

connection.title: Servers
connection.setupText: Choose an app, scan the QR code, or download the file.

telegramProxy.title: Access through Telegram
telegramProxy.subtitle: Use the Telegram link for the proxy on {node}. The HTTPS fallback stays available for copy or direct open.

platforms.title: How to start
platforms.subtitle: Choose your device and app. The link, QR code, manual, and matching configs will appear below.
platforms.scanToDownload: Scan the QR code with your phone camera to open the link.
platforms.configStep1: Install the app and open it.

vpn.name: AmneziaVPN
vpn.downloadHint: Use it for the .vpn profile and AmneziaVPN QR code.
vpn.configStep: In the app, add a connection and scan the AmneziaVPN QR code, or download the .vpn file below.

awg.name: AmneziaWG
awg.downloadHint: Use it for the .conf configuration and AmneziaWG QR code.
awg.configStep: In the app, import a tunnel and scan the AmneziaWG QR code, or download the .conf file below.

ios.name: iPhone and iPad
ios.configStep: On a phone, it is usually easier to scan the profile QR code from another screen.

android.name: Android
android.configStep: On a phone, it is usually easier to scan the profile QR code from another screen.

macos.name: macOS
macos.configStep: On a computer, it is usually easier to download the config file and import it.

windows.configStep: On a computer, it is usually easier to download the config file and import it.

linux.name: Linux
linux.configStep: On a computer, it is usually easier to download the config file and import it.

help.title: Need help?
help.text: If the connection does not appear or the server is not ready, refresh the page later or contact your administrator.

warnings.title: Attention
warnings.expiring: Your access is close to expiring. Ask the administrator to extend the subscription.
warnings.traffic: You are close to the traffic limit. Renew or reset the plan before access is blocked.

support.placeholder: Need renewal or support? Contact your administrator.

active.label: Access active
active.text: Your connection is ready. Use the QR code or file below.

blocked.label: Access closed
blocked.text: Connection is unavailable now. Contact your administrator.

limited.label: Limit reached
limited.text: Traffic has run out. Contact your administrator to renew access.

expired.label: Expired
expired.text: Access has ended. Contact your administrator.

states.blockedText: Connection is unavailable now. Contact your administrator.

configCard.configPreparingHint: Refresh the page in a minute or contact your administrator.
configCard.scanHint: Tap the QR code, then scan it in AmneziaWG.
configCard.scanHintVpn: Tap the QR code, then scan it in AmneziaVPN
configCard.qrUnavailableHint: Use the link below or download the file.
configCard.syncWarning: The last sync of this server reported an error. The configuration below keeps working, so downloads and the QR code stay available.
configCard.inactiveHint: Downloads and QR codes are closed while access is closed, expired or over the traffic limit.

devices.title: My devices
devices.subtitle: Every device has its own keys and its own configuration on each server.
devices.namePlaceholder: For example: Laptop, Phone, Work PC
devices.nameHint: The name is only shown to you and is used in the configuration description. Up to 64 characters.

nameErrors.too_long: The name is too long: 64 characters maximum.
nameErrors.control_chars: The name must not contain control characters.

devices.emptyText: Name the device you want to connect - for example Laptop or Phone. Its configuration appears as soon as the server confirms it, usually within a few seconds.
devices.limitNote: The device limit of {limit} is reached. Remove a device to free a slot.
devices.inactiveNote: You can view and remove your devices, but adding a device and downloading configurations is unavailable with this account state.
devices.inactiveEmptyText: This account has no devices to manage. Adding one needs active access: reconnect the account or contact the administrator.
devices.pendingNote: The server is preparing this device. Its configuration will appear here automatically.
devices.syncWarning: The last sync of {count} server(s) reported an error. Existing configurations keep working.
devices.noServers: No server is available for this device yet.
devices.deleteConfirmText: Its keys and configurations are revoked on every server right away, and the device slot is freed immediately. Traffic already counted stays on the account. This cannot be undone.

errors.limit: The device limit is reached. Remove a device or ask the administrator to raise the limit.

refresh.retryNotice: The page kept the data it already had. It will retry automatically.

apiErrors.not_found: This link is no longer valid. Ask the administrator for a new one.
apiErrors.blocked: Access to this account is closed, so the action was refused.
apiErrors.conflict: The action was refused: the device limit is already reached.
apiErrors.validation: The request was refused. Check the device name and try again.
apiErrors.network: The server did not answer. Check your connection.
apiErrors.server: The server could not complete the request. Try again a little later.
apiErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again a little later.
